claim: For a Standard workflow, starting an execution with the same name as a currently-running workflow automatically returns an idempotent response: the new workflow does not start, and an exception is thrown once the currently-running workflow is complete.
question: What happens when you start a Standard workflow execution with the same name as a running execution?

values.display: with the same name as a currently-running workflow

qualifiers.condition: an execution with the same name is currently running
